response.core_entity: Fibrosis and ulceration of skin/soft tissue

modifier_claims.support_quote: Patient admitted to self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
modifier_claims.value: skin and subcutaneous tissue of forearms and abdomen

modifier_claims.support_quote: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base
modifier_claims.value: cutaneous ulceration with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure

modifier_claims.support_quote: Shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes. Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa.
